correctness.rationale: For K_r join independent s vertices, every acyclic orientation determines a clique total order and one of r+1 gaps for each independent vertex; hence r!(r+1)^s vertices. One-skeleton edge flips are precisely cover-arc reversals in the acyclic reachability order. Each end-gap occupant contributes one cover edge, interior occupant two, and a clique consecutive edge contributes one iff its gap is empty: d(c)=c_0+c_r+2Σc_i(interior)+Σ1[c_i=0]. Thus d−(r+s−1)=Σ max(c_i−1,0), and exponential generating functions give D_{r,s}(z)=r!s![x^s] e^{2xz}(z+e^{xz²}−1)^{r−1}. Simple orientations have distinct occupants in interior gaps; injective placement yields r!Σ_{j≤min(r−1,s)}binom(r−1,j)s!/(s−j)! 2^{s−j}. Sliding interior occupants left across empty gaps and then right-end occupants left, followed by adjacent clique-label swaps with all independent vertices in an end gap, gives connectedness through only simple orientations. Constructed degree support [r+s−1,r+2s−2] for s≥2, maximum r!(r−1); for s=1 every vertex has degree r. Independently enumerated all orientations and cover degrees for r,s=(2,1),(2,2),(3,2), matching exact histograms. No finite enumeration replaces the gap/cover proof.
